body.en: Handwoven on Tangail looms in soft cotton. 6 yards long with a matching blouse piece. Colours: red, green and navy blue. Hand wash in cold water.

body.en: Pure mulberry silk from Rajshahi with a printed border. Lightweight and suitable for weddings and festivals. Colours: maroon, mustard and teal. Dry clean only.
